page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s3 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores, resulting in 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per CPU core. It does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating system and application deployment.

With dedicated CPU allocation and a low RAM-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is structured for compute-heavy tasks that do not demand large memory footprints. The lack of hyperthreading ensures predictable single-threaded execution on each dedicated core. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile represents a budget-friendly entry point for dedicated compute resources, minimizing memory overhead costs. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web servers, basic computational tasks, microservices, and development environments that require dedicated CPU cycles without high memory or storage requirements.
